title: Verify with gov.br
summary: Trust step 5 (bipe-chat/bipe#544, docs/identity.md): the person signs a short Bipe document in the gov.br app and sends the signed file back. Two taps in Bipe: one out to gov.br, one back through the share sheet. The server makes the PDF and reads name and CPF from the signature; the person types nothing.

phase.description: ready: bipe_govbr_title, bipe_govbr_intro, the three bipe_govbr_step_* lines, bipe_govbr_safety and bipe_govbr_start. preparing: a spinner while the challenge loads. waitingForSignature: the PDF is saved and gov.br opened; bipe_govbr_already_signed and bipe_govbr_get_app show. checking: bipe_govbr_checking. verified: bipe_govbr_verified with the name. rejected: the reason string and bipe_govbr_retry. failed: bipe_govbr_retry.

reason.description: rejected only: VerificationStatus.reason (not_signed and so on in the API), shown as bipe_govbr_reason_<reason in snake case>.

verifiedName.description: verified only: the name in the new badge.

start.effect: bipe_govbr_start, and bipe_govbr_retry: POST /v1/verifications/govbr. Saves the PDF under registries/govbr.json fileName where the gov.br file picker shows it (iOS: the system save dialog; Android: Downloads through MediaStore), then opens the gov.br app (iOS: iosStoreUrl, which shows Abrir when the app is installed; Android: androidPackage, else playStoreUrl). Sets waitingForSignature.

receiveFile.effect: A PDF shared to Bipe (iOS: a PDF document type handled in onOpenURL; Android: ACTION_SEND or ACTION_VIEW with application/pdf). In waitingForSignature: PUT /v1/verifications/govbr/{verificationId}/document at once, phase checking, then verified, rejected or failed. With no open verification: bipe_govbr_no_open_verification and no upload. Over maxDocumentBytes: rejected with not_signed.

alreadySigned.effect: bipe_govbr_already_signed: the system PDF picker (iOS UIDocumentPicker for .pdf; Android OpenDocument for application/pdf), then the same upload as receiveFile.

close.effect: Closes. After verified the trust card reads the badge again and step 5 shows done.

notes: Only while registries/govbr.json enabled is true; else trust step 5 shows Em breve and nothing opens this screen. Entry: the govbr step of trust-profile only (bipe-chat/bipe#277: never from a chat, a link or a notification).
The open verification lives in memory for the app session; a file that arrives after the app restarted has no open verification.
Bipe never asks for the gov.br password or code, and never sends a document to sign in a message (bipe_govbr_safety).
bipe_govbr_needs_level shows under the intro: gov.br signing needs a silver or gold account.
Logic: BipeGovbrFlow (BipeKit BipeGovbrFlow.swift; libraries/bipe shared/BipeGovbrFlow.kt), the same phases on both platforms.
